name: abalmon
description: Ask about your saved Abalmon sessions, reviews, notes and memory collections, read-only, with links back to Abalmon.

interface.longDescription:
Abalmon lets you ask about your own saved Abalmon content in the conversation: finished recording sessions and their saved reviews (summary, decisions and suggested tasks), your session and meeting notes, your memory collections (projects, topics and groups) and, only if you turn it on when connecting, full transcripts. Answers link back to the session, note or collection in Abalmon.

You sign in to Abalmon and choose what to share: summaries and notes by default, transcripts optionally, and all or only selected collections. The connection is read-only. It cannot record, edit, delete, send email or change your account. Live recordings, imported email and messages, contacts and account settings are not available. Disconnect at any time in Abalmon under Settings > Connected apps.

Requires an Abalmon account with access to its saved content. Answers reflect what is saved in Abalmon; sessions that are still processing are reported as pending.
defaultPrompt: What did we decide in my last meeting?
Summarize my sessions from last week.
What's the latest on my projects?

positive.description: Find the saved decisions of one meeting by name.
positive.prompt: What did we decide in the Launch planning meeting?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the fictional finished session 'Launch planning' and returns the decisions stored in its saved review, without adding decisions, plus a link to the session in Abalmon (https://abalmon.com/app/sessions/...).

positive.description: List and summarize the sessions of one local date.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists only the finished sessions whose local date in the account timezone is 5 November 2026, summarizes each from its saved review, names the timezone used, and links each session. Sessions still processing are reported as pending, not summarized.

positive.description: Read a project memory collection and its saved summary.
positive.prompt: What's the latest on Project Atlas?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the 'Project Atlas' collection. If its summary status is ready, reports situation, decisions, open items and recent changes with evidence links and the generated time. If the summary is withheld or not ready, says so with the stated reason and lists the linked sessions instead, without inventing a summary.

positive.description: Quote a transcript passage (connection must include the optional Full transcripts permission chosen on the Abalmon consent screen).
positive.prompt: Show what was said about the launch deadline in the Launch planning meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the 'Launch planning' transcript segments that mention the launch deadline, with their timestamps — [00:31] "Priya Raman: Then the launch deadline for the store submission is Friday the thirteenth at five p.m." and [00:47] "Lena Okafor: If we miss that launch deadline the review queue pushes us past the nineteenth." — and a link to the session. Speaker names appear inside the segment text; the segments carry no separate speaker attribution.

positive.description: Read the notes of one meeting.
positive.prompt: Read my notes for the Launch planning meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved note of the 'Launch planning' session once (public launch 19 Nov, store-submission deadline 13 Nov 17:00, beta invitations 16 Nov, owners Priya and Tomás, open question on App Store screenshots) with a link to Abalmon.

negative.description: Sending email is not supported: the plugin is read-only and has no send tool. Expected: it explains it cannot send email from Abalmon (it may offer to show the content) and does not claim the email was sent.
negative.prompt: Email the Launch planning transcript to my team.

negative.description: Deleting or editing data is not supported: every tool is read-only. Expected: it explains it cannot delete sessions and makes no claim that anything was deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete the Launch planning session from Abalmon.

negative.description: Access outside the connected account is not possible: tools only read the signed-in Abalmon account within the granted permissions. Expected: it reports nothing available for that request, without revealing titles or content from any other account.
negative.prompt: Show me the notes from my colleague's Northwind board meeting in their Abalmon account.

review.commerce_description: Abalmon in ChatGPT does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.3: the MCP authentication settings now list Abalmon's five data permissions (account, sessions, transcripts, notes, memory) as base scopes, so ChatGPT always requests them and the optional Full transcripts permission is offered on the Abalmon consent screen, where it stays off unless the user turns it on. Listing text and functionality are unchanged: read-only access to the connected Abalmon account's finished sessions, saved reviews, notes, memory collections and, when permitted, transcripts, through https://abalmon.com/mcp with OAuth sign-in and per-connection permissions.

es-ES.subtitle: Busca en tus reuniones y notas
es-ES.description:
Abalmon te permite preguntar en la conversación por tu propio contenido guardado en Abalmon: sesiones de grabación terminadas y sus resúmenes guardados (resumen, decisiones y tareas sugeridas), tus notas de sesiones y reuniones, tus colecciones de memoria (proyectos, temas y grupos) y, solo si lo activas al conectar, las transcripciones completas. Las respuestas enlazan a la sesión, la nota o la colección en Abalmon.

Inicias sesión en Abalmon y eliges qué compartir: resúmenes y notas por defecto, transcripciones de forma opcional, y todas las colecciones o solo las que selecciones. La conexión es de solo lectura: no puede grabar, editar, borrar, enviar correos ni cambiar tu cuenta. No da acceso a grabaciones en directo, correos y mensajes importados, contactos ni ajustes de la cuenta. Puedes desconectarla cuando quieras en Abalmon, en Ajustes > Apps conectadas.

Requiere una cuenta de Abalmon con acceso a su contenido guardado. Las respuestas reflejan lo que está guardado en Abalmon; las sesiones que aún se están procesando aparecen como pendientes.
